versions.changelog: Minimize the runtime to a hash-verified analysis-only dependency set, remove flagged UI/web/PDF packages, upgrade idna and yt-dlp to current patched releases, and recreate the managed environment on approved bootstrap.

Harden VideoLens security: isolate subprocess environments, require separate runtime-install consent, enforce loopback task access and pinned/clean runtime integrity, install lock-verified dependencies, redact user inputs, and document permissions and data flow.
Fix ClawHub image rendering with stable absolute asset URLs and add a prominent labeled Chrome extension link.

Modernize VideoLens for current OpenClaw: add portable direct execution, all nine analysis modes, pinned runtime updates, a working Python fallback, accurate HTML/Markdown/JSON artifacts, current YouTube-report and Chrome/Pro positioning, refreshed assets, and tighter spend/privacy guardrails.
Tighten positioning around AI video reviews from prompts; remove product-demo QA as a primary category; fix install naming and cleaner ClawHub copy.

Initial release: OpenClaw-ready VideoLens.io skill with BYOK local analysis, cloud positioning, timestamped video QA prompts, OCC local skill runner config, and SVG screenshots. Published under the clean videolens slug.
